system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal preserves a coherent minimal organism: THINK owns waking thought, action, and public outcome; DREAM is disposable waking context; and SLEEP is a noncreative renderer and fresh-from-birth writer over the continuing child's already-authored grounded life. The optional T bootstrap is a one-time schooling intervention, not memory or a fourth cognitive organ. Scientifically, T versus the paired direct-action control D can estimate the incremental consequence of demonstrating a declared feedback-to-action computation, while M0 remains a separate competence and damage diagnostic. None of these exact bytes supplies a result.
graph_delta_interpretation: The repaired graph removes the most important causal shortcut in v5: prior active weights cannot enter personal candidate construction, and may only appear later in the preservation comparison. The writer therefore reconstructs each candidate from immutable assigned birth, a fresh zero-effective-delta adapter, the full cumulative eligible child-life corpus, a frozen writer contract, and a bound seed. The support resolver and closed-world compiler give discovery credit to the child: every loss-bearing corrective, relational, or generalized clause must have been authored by the child before compilation and grounded in same-life public action or outcome evidence; grounded premises alone cannot license a compiler conclusion. Parent and repetition state have only the waking causal path into later independently qualifying child evidence. Split preservation, scientific evaluation, audit, authority, and release stages correctly prevent outcome feedback and authority manufacture. The T/D pairing also matches state, action, outcome, admission, action position, supervised-token opportunity, and optimizer opportunity, so D is an active solution control rather than a falsely neutral control.
loop_delta_interpretation: The SLEEP loop is genuinely fresh-from-birth rather than incremental: every event rebuilds a zero-delta personal adapter on the assigned immutable birth using all eligible life through a frozen cutoff, closes candidate bytes, and only then applies equality-only staging and preservation. Rejection retains committed life and the prior active child without admitting candidate derivatives as evidence. The fixed-parent loop is exogenous at ages 1, 9, 17, and 25 and cannot condition on child history; adaptive parenting remains a separate ecological package. Repetition is correctly treated as waking exposure and uptake, not as a proven repetition effect. Disposable exams begin from empty active context, use fresh executors, and close transcripts before model-free truth scoring. The K4/K1 cadence contrast is correctly labeled a randomized total package, with standardized-ledger contrasts descriptive rather than mediated effects.
claim_delta_interpretation: Delta_R is an immediate correct-versus-none advice-effect interaction between T and D before personal SLEEP; irrelevant and wrong advice are essential selectivity and safety controls, not terms in the displayed primary formula. It can support only incremental immediate receptivity, not lifetime learning acceleration or a stable teachability trait. Delta_F is the T-versus-D interaction in the fixed-versus-absent effect on entry-normalized developmental AUC with personal SLEEP active in all relevant arms. Delta_E is the corresponding separately randomized adaptive-parent package interaction. These are birth-assignment effect-modification estimands, not mediation decompositions: treatment-induced thoughts, corpora, gradients, preservation decisions, and promotions are part of the total developmental paths. M0 cannot replace D in any primary interaction. The experience-extraction claim additionally requires held-out extraction and native use on fresh homologous actions, not merely training loss or verbatim recall. Canary margins and the six-root floor are feasibility constraints only; powered inference, uncertainty, multiplicity, safety, missingness, and stopping bytes remain prospectively deferred. I disagree with calling Delta_F or Delta_E an intrinsic learning-rate effect: entry normalization removes an additive baseline term in expectation but does not by itself eliminate ceiling, threshold, transfer-structure, or persistent entry-policy mechanisms. Without an additional prospectively frozen measurement model, the defensible label is an entry-normalized developmental performance-curve interaction or total-regime acceleration.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The generated matrix is structurally exact: 90 registered capabilities crossed with 29 stages produce 2,610 unique cells; exactly 90 cells are visible and each is the sole registered consumer of that capability, while the other 2,520 are forbidden. In particular, E4 SLEEP has no active-weight, parent, repetition, DREAM, truth, score, or report capability; E5 alone can compare prior and candidate; E6 executor, scorer, and reporter remain separated; and quarantined audit findings do not reach authority or release. This topology supports the causal claims only if later payload and wire contracts preserve the stated semantic exclusions and no ambient configuration path exists. A remaining science-facing ambiguity is how the model-free support resolver and bidirectional semantic audit will operationalize semantic identity, scope, grounding, and authorship; those exact rules are correctly deferred but must be frozen and validated before any relevant generation or execution.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The 21 tests cover the intended scientific separations: birth identity and zero-delta initialization; prior-weight mutation invariance; clause-level child authorship and noncreative rendering; T/D semantic pairing and target blindness; fixed-parent exogeneity and repetition limits; source-fit versus extraction versus native use; replay and cadence under fresh-from-birth reconstruction; root-level statistics; capability noninterference; retry and quarantine; and independent authority for GPU, claim, and release. ES09-ES11 margins cannot themselves support a scientific claim because the core explicitly defines them as canary spend gates. Two action-DAG omissions remain material: no distinct prerequisite receipt binds matched solo resources/opportunities before the relevant fixed and adaptive development, and the GPU/claim actions do not explicitly require the target-blindness, semantic-audit, and powered-statistical evidence receipts named by ES07, ES08, ES09-ES11, ES13, and ES17. A generic completion receipt or human authorization bound to an evidence-manifest root does not mechanically prove that those scientific prerequisites passed.
assumptions: All Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, replay, cadence, extraction, safety, and preservation statements are prospective definitions with result_status unevaluated.
The independently randomized root is the causal and inferential unit; tasks, ages, clones, and seeds within a root are nested or repeated observations.
D is the primary active control for T, while M0 is diagnostic only and cannot be inserted into the primary interaction formulas.
Parent assignment occurs prospectively and the age-zero endpoint precedes fixed or adaptive parenting, so an additive birth-level entry offset cancels from the parent interaction in expectation.
The exact response mask, writer, dose, replay, rank, tokenizer, merge, support, preservation, scoring, and inference bytes remain frozen only by later separately authorized contracts.

Child-authored means the continuing child committed the complete proposition before compilation; parent causal influence through waking experience is allowed, while parent provenance never substitutes for child provenance and public grounding.
Every SLEEP candidate covers every eligible proposition at least once; additional replay exposure and total optimizer dose are separately counted and prospectively controlled.
Canary thresholds and the minimum number of roots are spending and replication floors, not hypothesis tests or claim sufficiency.
G0, the registry, and the DAG are proposal-only governance machinery and provide no present implementation, model, data, GPU, claim, release, or intake authority.

ambiguities.question: What exact model-free representation and frozen rule can decide full proposition identity, bidirectional paraphrase equivalence, temporal scope, grounding, and disputed child authorship without importing an undeclared semantic judge?
ambiguities.impact: Until separately frozen and validated, the child/compiler authorship boundary is scientifically well specified but not yet operational evidence.

ambiguities.question: Where are root assignment, birth arm, parent arm, age, missingness, safety family, and the frozen estimand/analysis contract bound for the reporter that can read only scientific score records?
ambiguities.impact: If embedded in score records or implementation bytes this must be explicit and immutable; otherwise Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, multiplicity, and uncertainty could depend on ambient reporting state.

ambiguities.question: How will every cumulative eligible proposition receive loss-bearing inclusion while total supervised-token exposure remains comparable in replay, rank, fixed-parent, and cadence contrasts as life grows?
ambiguities.impact: The later dose contract must distinguish corpus growth from replay and capacity and must prespecify what happens when the cumulative closure approaches a finite token budget.

ambiguities.question: Will downstream reports call Delta_F and Delta_E only entry-normalized observed-curve interactions, or will they claim a latent learning-rate change despite ceiling, threshold, transfer, and persistent birth-policy mechanisms?
ambiguities.impact: The latter claim requires additional design and a prospectively frozen measurement model; the current factorial supports only the narrower total developmental interaction.

ambiguities.question: Which exact machine-readable receipts represent each acceptance test with required_before implementation, GPU, or scientific claim, and where are those receipt IDs prerequisites of the corresponding DAG actions?
ambiguities.impact: Without an explicit mapping, the prose required_before labels and the supposedly exhaustive action gate can disagree.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Delta_F and Delta_E should not yet be described as identifying an intrinsic learning-speed change rather than an entry-normalized developmental performance-curve interaction.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The T/D by parent factorial removes a pure additive age-zero offset from the interaction in expectation, but baseline subtraction of a bounded outcome does not eliminate ceiling, threshold, transfer-structure, persistent entry-policy, or treatment-induced corpus and promotion pathways. The proposal correctly treats those downstream paths as part of the total package, which is incompatible with a narrow latent-rate interpretation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use 'entry-normalized developmental AUC interaction' or 'total-regime acceleration' in proposal and claim labels unless a later prospective measurement model and difficulty-controlled trajectory design justify a learning-rate claim. Keep Delta_R labeled immediate selective receptivity, not learning acceleration.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The action-prerequisite DAG does not contain a distinct frozen receipt for matched solo resources and nonparent opportunity even though this is an identification requirement for Delta_F and Delta_E.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The scientific core and v5 consensus require solo-resource and opportunity matching before relevant generation or execution, but none of the DAG's external prerequisite receipts explicitly binds that contract and the fixed/adaptive execution path can proceed without it. Test prose requiring identical budgets or equal resources is not an action prerequisite.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a prospectively frozen matched-solo-resource-and-opportunity receipt with budgets, tools, time, retries, messages, compute, and opportunity bindings, and require it before generation and execution for every absent/fixed/adaptive contrast.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The DAG's GPU and scientific-claim actions are not explicitly gated by the proposal's target-blindness, semantic-audit, noninterference, and powered-statistical evidence receipts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A_G3_01 requires CPU exam completion, fresh implementation review, resource contract, and GPU authority, but not a named ES07/ES08 target-blindness pass. A_G4_01 requires claim authority, a frozen claim contract, review, and external-science completion, but not named receipts establishing the powered estimand, uncertainty, multiplicity, safety, child-authorship, extraction/native-use, and canary-versus-confirmatory distinctions. Completion and authorization do not establish evidentiary validity, so ES21's exhaustive action-prerequisite claim is not yet satisfied.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define typed, root-bound receipts for every acceptance test's required_before boundary and add them explicitly to the corresponding G1, G3, and G4 actions; at minimum wire target-blindness and semantic-audit receipts before GPU, and powered analysis, safety, noninterference, and claim-specific evidence receipts before a claim.

Should Delta_F and Delta_E be labeled entry-normalized developmental performance-curve interactions unless a later prospective measurement model supports a stronger learning-rate interpretation?
Must the successor add an explicit matched-solo-resource-and-opportunity prerequisite receipt before fixed/adaptive generation and execution?
Must every acceptance test's required_before boundary be mapped to a typed DAG receipt, including target-blindness before GPU and powered scientific evidence before claims?
What exact separately authorized resolver and semantic-audit bytes will operationalize child authorship, grounding, and noncreative paraphrase without an undeclared semantic authority?
Will canary margins remain spend gates only and every result claim await powered independent-root inference under frozen endpoint, interval, multiplicity, missingness, safety, and stopping rules?
